newsitem.title: USA: Trans World sets four-day systemwide sale.
newsitem.headline: Trans World sets four-day systemwide sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said on Tuesday it set a four-day systemwide sale, offering discounts of up to 55 percent on domestic 21-day fares and up to 44 percent on destinations in Europe and Egypt.
TWA said domestic destinations include Toronto, Canada, but exclude Honolulu and San Juan, Puerto Rico.
Reservations must be made between today and November 15.

There is no advance purchase requirement for international sale tickets for departures through November 18. But there is a seven-day advance purchase requirement for travel starting November 19 and later.
Domestic tickets require a 14-day advance purchase.
All tickets are non-refundable and must be purchased no later than midnight three days after reservations are made.
A Saturday night stay is required and minimum stay requirements vary by departure date and destination.

While most international travel can begin immediately, domestic travel cannot begin before November 26 and must be completed by February 13. International travel must be completed by December 13. A 13-day maximum stay on all travel is permitted.
Holiday blackout dates and other restrictions apply.
